messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "some tablets are made with a shell that is not absorbed or melted in the body"
set: ["some tablets are made with a shell that is not absorbed or melted in the body", "shell that is not absorbed or melted in the body", "Some tablets", "some blood pressure tablets", "taking with food causes only a small increase in the amount absorbed", "conditions that lower oxygen levels in the body", "seeing or hearing things that are not real", "that is a separate benefit", "tablets and oral liquid are not interchangeable", "replacing thyroid hormone that your body is not making enough of", "some forms are taken only once daily with the evening meal", "well absorbed", "take the tablets with a full glass of water", "not broken down by the body", "change how much is in your body", "heart failure that is not under control"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
